title: Zesty Chewy Greek Lamb Kleftiko
description: A quick and flavorful Greek dish featuring lamb, sun-dried tomatoes, and a mortar-pestle-pound technique, served in a molcajete vessel.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a molcajete vessel, combine lamb, sun-dried tomatoes, oregano, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Using a mortar-pestle-pound technique, mash the ingredients together until they are well combined and the lamb is coated with the mixture.
Cover the molcajete with plastic wrap and let it marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Remove the plastic wrap and transfer the molcajete to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the meat is easily shredded with a fork.
Remove the molcajete from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the lamb kleftiko hot, garnished with additional oregano and lemon wedges if desired.
